choice: retain whole-library audit; approve only individually audited Bird, Fairy, Bog, Hunter, Ooze and Hedgerow abilities
why: Copies, summons and text theft can reach definitions not present as an initial active board unit; whole-library masking plus recursive input masking preserves that closure. Unseen native IDs and unseen/missing pass3 abilities remain unsupported. Bog Jenny and Lantern are masked by ability; other Bog abilities remain intact, with Snap masked separately. Hunter Isegrim is a biggest-enemy combat selector; Ermeline ranks marked bell snapshots only for a post-fight reward. Other Hunter abilities do not select the biggest enemy. Ooze Hasty Pudding ranks enemies, including held bodies, and is masked; every other Ooze ability reads own bodies, follows a damage killer, or reacts to a friendly release and stays intact. Hedgerow audits all sixteen native abilities independently: recruit stat ranking is friendly only, Urchin protects by reverse Pass order, and Sergeant-at-Conkers aims across its source slot while spending actual Larder items. None selects an enemy by size; unknown Hedgerow abilities remain unsupported.
